actions.description: Obtain physical DUT marking/package/suffix evidence, select matching package pinout, and identify programmer and TXU0304 orderable package/footprint/availability.

Obtain declared limits for every interface; check VIH/VIL against loaded VOH/VOL, supply tolerance, load and temperature; compute forward clock/data skew and return-path propagation plus DUT clock-to-output and host setup/hold across modes 0/3. Set no clock rate until margins are demonstrated.

Specify local 1.8 V regulator, input source, tolerance/transients/current budget, decoupling and protection; validate OE bias/control, partial-power/back-power behavior, sequencing, and all unused DUT pins using selected component specifications. Keep default power off.
Produce package-specific schematic and layout, review mapping and power states, and obtain ERC/DRC and independent design review. No fabrication authorization is conveyed.

After separate applicable authorization, obtain physical identity, continuity, rail-under-load, OE/sequencing and signal/timing measurements. Record results with provenance; no measurements or power authorization exist in this plan.

architecture_candidates.description: A domain 3.3 V host, B domain local 1.8 V DUT; both target rails lie inside translator declared operating ranges. Logical mapping: SCLK -> A1 -> B1Y -> CLK; CS# -> A2 -> B2Y -> /CS; MOSI_IO0 -> A3 -> B3Y -> DI_IO0; DO_IO1 -> B4 -> A4Y -> MISO_IO1. These are signal names, not package pin numbers. Shared reference ground is a design requirement. OE low is the intended disabled state; implementation and all power-state behavior remain unresolved. Standard SPI only; no dual/quad compatibility inferred.

Rails are range-compatible, but two shared-direction two-channel groups cannot simultaneously provide three forward and one reverse channels. A 2+2 allocation lacks a third forward channel; 4+0 lacks return. Additional devices could be reconsidered but are not specified.

At declared 1.8 V VCC, pin absolute maximum is 2.2 V; declared 3.3 V host drive exceeds it by 1.1 V. Across operating VCC the upper absolute limit is 2.1–2.35 V. Absolute maximum is not a valid operating logic target. Direct 3.3 V DUT supply also exceeds 1.95 V operating maximum.

assessment.summary: Declared page-addressed evidence supports a conditional TXU0304 standard-SPI logical architecture. Physical correctness remains UNPROVEN.
